name: Blackjack
tagline: Beat the dealer to 21. Friends who open your invite play their own hands.
description:
Hit, stand, or double. Split a pair. Aces are soft until they have to be one. The dealer stands on 17. A natural 21 pays 3:2. Go broke and the table says so; restock deals you a fresh pile.

Your chips are saved with your copy of the app — share the file and the table goes with it. One link sits friends at the same table. The host deals. The dealer plays in the host's browser.

An unofficial port of blackjack by hanhaechi.
